backgrounds: A single continuous domestic set viewed from one fixed camera position: a dim apartment hallway (numbered door '3', light switch, framed photos on the walls) that frames a doorway into a warmly lit bedroom. The bedroom shows a bed with dark blanket, a curtained window, and a vanity/dressing table with a round mirror where the woman applies makeup. The man stands in the foreground hallway, in near-darkness, checking his phone while waiting; the woman is deeper in frame in the brighter bedroom. Title/credit cards use a plain black background with centered text. Only one location (the apartment) is used throughout the episode.
props: round wall mirror above the vanity
vanity table crowded with makeup items (compact, brushes, bottles, palette)
makeup brush the woman uses on her face
framed photographs on hallway and bedroom walls
door with brass/gold doorknob and number plaque '3'
small round rug on bedroom floor
lighting_notes: Strong contrast between a dark, underlit foreground hallway (man in near-silhouette, cool bluish-gray tones) and a warmer, brighter bedroom background (soft ceiling light, warm window light) where the woman stands. This creates a natural vignette/frame-within-a-frame that pushes focus toward the lit bedroom while keeping the man's deadpan expression readable in low-key shadow. Title cards are plain black with high-contrast gold/white text.
color_palette: charcoal/dark gray (hallway walls and man's suit)
warm cream/off-white (bedroom walls and man's shirt)
warm brown/caramel (woman's sweater and wood furniture)
visual_complexity_notes: The set is modest and largely static: one hallway-to-bedroom composition reused across the whole episode with no camera movement or additional locations, keeping visual complexity low so attention stays on the two characters' expressions and dialogue timing (subtitles overlaid at bottom of frame). The framing device of doorway-within-doorway is a deliberate minimalist staging choice typical of stop-motion shorts, using depth and light contrast rather than set variety to add visual interest.
